_comment: CLS-FINANCIAL-TABLE-DELETABLE / ACCT-F133 — financial tables that still grant DELETE to ih35_app.
VOID LAW: every transaction can be VOIDED; NOTHING can be DELETED. For a journal entry, voiding IS
a reversing entry (reversal_of_line_id / reversed_by_line_id) — the ledger stays balanced. So the
control is uniform and simple: no financial table grants DELETE. Records stay voidable either way.
SHRINK-ONLY. This list is the frozen starting point, read live from prod 2026-08-05. The guard FAILS
when a table NOT on this list gains a DELETE grant — that is the ratchet. When a table is revoked it
is reported as shrinkable and removed with --update; the list may never grow by hand.
WHY IT IS NOT ZERO ALREADY: revoking all 58 at once is a large behavioural change across paths that
legitimately delete today, and it needs per-table rehearsal. driver_finance.driver_settlements
(ACCT-F130) and accounting.journal_entry_postings (ACCT-F131) are the first two revoked; they still
appear here until those migrations land on main, at which point this list shrinks to 56.
The capability is LIVE and USED, which is why this is a ratchet and not a note:
driver_finance.driver_settlements showed n_tup_del = 7 with no soft-delete column and no audit
coverage — seven financial rows gone with no trace and no recoverable identity.
